title: Indirect contradictions beyond the direct SIMON boundaries
summary: Determine whether indirect contradictions extend the maximum impossible-differential length beyond the direct-contradiction boundary for each larger SIMON block size.

formal_statement.body: For each $v\in\{48,64,96,128\}$, let $L_v^{\mathrm{dir}}$ be the maximum round length of a SIMON-$v$ impossible differential under the source's direct-contradiction model, and let $L_v^{\mathrm{all}}$ be the maximum when its indirect-contradiction model is also allowed. Is $L_v^{\mathrm{all}}=L_v^{\mathrm{dir}}$ for all four values of $v$? For each variant, prove equality by an exhaustive certificate or give a verified indirect-contradiction distinguisher showing a strict inequality.

scope.domain: Direct and indirect impossible differential cryptanalysis of SIMON48, SIMON64, SIMON96, and SIMON128
assumptions: Direct and indirect contradictions use the source definitions
The practical-boundary convention is the one defined by the source
Each comparison uses the same fixed-key SIMON variant and truncated-difference model
scope.unresolved_remainder: Later restricted or incomplete models recover the known best round lengths and find no longer indirect distinguisher, but none gives either a beyond-boundary witness or an exhaustive absence certificate for SIMON48, SIMON64, SIMON96, or SIMON128.

citations.label: Zhang--Wang--Lai--Wang--Guan--Hu--Shi, indirect-contradiction problem
citations.locator: Section V-C, discussion item 2, journal p. 6038

progress.summary: The source asks how to determine whether indirect contradictions invalidate the direct-model practical boundary in its larger-SIMON analysis.
